method.name: custom-primary-plus-coauthor-commit-ranking
method.authors: GitHub Commit.authors; first entry is primary
method.scope: All commits reachable from the pinned default-branch head; no history filters
method.completeness: Resolved SHA set and explicitly unresolved SHA set form a disjoint, exact partition of independent Git rev-list
method.paginationCompleteMeaning: All GraphQL history pages and available author connections were fully read; this does not mean all commit author objects were available
method.unresolvedCommitRule: A missing commit is unresolved only when both oid and full-SHA expression lookups return explicit null objects in valid repositories; other errors fail the run
method.deduplication: One count per (commit SHA, user.id); primary takes precedence
method.coauthoredCommits: Coauthor-only commits; excludes commits also credited as primary
method.ranking: rank is the competition rank of verified known totals, not necessarily the complete rank; display ties by login.casefold(), then user.id
method.bounds: For U unresolved commits, every account has known <= total <= known+U. rank_min=1+count(other known > own known+U); rank_max=1+count(other known+U > own known), or null when own known<U because unseen accounts may outrank it
method.unlinkedAuthorNote: GitActor.user=null may include bot identities. No account is inferred from names or email addresses.
method.attributionTiming: Commit set is pinned; GitHub account associations are observed during this run and may change later.
